text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race, Admire Groove was 
radiating an extraordinary drive."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not going to say anything to 
her? Even though you fuss over her so much 
usually."
choice_data_list: I thought I'd just be in the way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need for your concern. My 
heart will not be swayed so easily at this 
point...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No. In fact, I will overcome it. Any 
adversity, with my own two legs..."
